response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer with deep web/full-stack experience and some high-performance systems work, but the role centers on modern C++ development for industrial automation with IEC 62443 secure-development practices. His C++ experience is limited to a brief six-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago and a bachelor thesis project; his recent decade is dominated by TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang. There is no evidence of industrial cybersecurity, MQTT/IoT protocol work, or SDL practices, making him a poor match despite his overall seniority.
strengths: Extensive senior-level experience (15+ years) with strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
High-performance, low-latency systems experience (async I/O, fibers, caching, millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Proven mentoring and knowledge-sharing track record through workshops, courses, and open-source projects
concerns: Very limited and dated C++ experience (~6 months in 2014–2015), while the role is C++-centric
No industrial automation, IEC 62443, SDL, or protocol experience (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA, DNP 3.0)
Recent career trajectory is web/full-stack (TypeScript/Node.js), diverging from embedded/industrial systems focus

key_factors.factor: High-performance systems and senior engineering experience
